title.en: Unrushed attention from Dr Effie Gionnopoulos

text.en: Long-standing clients and recent visitors praise Dr Effie for her gentle demeanour, calm presence, and willingness to work late into the evening answering client enquiries. Reviewers consistently highlight that examinations feel unhurried, with the veterinary team taking genuine time to listen to owner concerns.

Owners of nervous dogs and companion rabbits commend Dr Effie's specialised understanding of animal temperament. Reviews note that reactive dogs are handled with patience to help them relax without excessive sedation, while rabbit guardians appreciate knowledgeable exotic mammal care.

title.en: Reliable clinical management for diverse species

text.en: Pet guardians report enduring satisfaction with therapeutic outcomes across multiple years of care, spanning routine preventive check-ups to specialised rabbit treatments. Reviewers feel confident in the clinic's diagnostic competence, noting that long-term medical guidance has kept their animals thriving.

q.en: Does Dr Effie treat rabbits and small exotic mammals?

a.en: Yes, clients specifically recommend Dr Effie for knowledgeable rabbit examinations and small animal medical care.

q.en: How does the veterinary team manage anxious or reactive dogs?

a.en: Reviewers note that staff take time to build trust and calm nervous pets rather than immediately recommending sedatives.

q.en: Are new appointments available for canine and feline patients?

a.en: Yes, clients report smooth check-in procedures for both routine dog and cat appointments and specialised consultations.
